ActivityEnvironment.description: Where the session happened, `unknown` when the preset does not impose one.

ActivityEquipmentType.description: A known piece of gear, or `other` with a free name (PRD_ACTIVITIES 8.4).

ActivityMetric.description: One measured quantity of a session, in the integer unit its kind determines.

ActivityMetricKind.description: The measured quantity. Its canonical unit is derived from the kind and never carried, so an impossible pair (a distance in kilocalories) cannot be expressed.

ActivityMetricSource.description: Where a metric's value came from (PRD_ACTIVITIES 8.3).

ActivitySessionPayloadV1.description: A finished session with its metrics, equipment, exercises and sets, payload schema version 1. The aggregate is atomic: PRD section 10.2 forbids a session appearing without its mandatory children.

ActivitySessionUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of a whole activity session, payload schema version 1.

ActivitySource.description: How the session entered Mue. `agent` is an MCP creation and is not one of Android's three ids; an unknown id degrades to `manual` on the client.

AggregateId.description: Stable aggregate identifier. A UUID when the aggregate has no natural key, the natural key when it has one (a Measurement is identified by its local date).

AggregateMeta.description: Synchronisation metadata carried by every aggregate (PRD section 12.1).

BirthDate.description: ISO-8601 calendar date of birth, year 1900-2099. The bound is absolute so a journalled payload never expires; the author's own rule (not in the future, not more than 120 years back) is the client's, and this server does not re-adjudicate it (PRD section 14.4).

BodyCompositionV1.description: Estimated body composition for one weighing, with the exact snapshot of the inputs it was derived from (PRD_SCALE 12.3, 13.2, 21.1). An optional child of its measurement and never an aggregate of its own (BR-SCALE-006); `inputWeightCg` always equals the parent's `weightCg` (BR-SCALE-015) and `fatFreeMassCg` never exceeds it.

CounterString.description: A 64-bit counter in canonical decimal form, carried as a string.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Store and return it verbatim; never parse it.

CursorPayload.description: Decoded cursor. Server-side only: clients receive and return the encoded string.

CustomExerciseDefinitionPayloadV1.description: A personal exercise definition, payload schema version 1. It carries no `isCustom`: a provided definition is not personal data and cannot be expressed here (PRD section 10.1).

CustomExerciseDefinitionUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of a personal exercise definition, payload schema version 1.

DeleteMutation.description: Deletion of any aggregate. Produces a tombstone, never a hard erase.

Estimation.description: Whether the line's numbers were weighed or estimated. PRD_FOOD 13.2 makes an approximation visible rather than hidden.

ExerciseDefinitionSnapshot.description: The definition an exercise points at, copied into the session so the session can always be applied (PRD section 10.2).

ExerciseTrackingMode.description: Which fields a set of this exercise carries (PRD_ACTIVITIES 9.2).

FoodLogEntryPayloadV1.description: One consumption with its own nutritional snapshot, payload schema version 1. Self-contained: it does not depend on its food or its recipe having arrived (PRD section 10.2).

FoodLogEntryUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of one journal line with its snapshot, payload schema version 1.

FoodLogKind.description: Whether the line came from a food, a recipe or a quick add (PRD_FOOD 10.2).

FoodPayloadV1.description: A custom food or a copied Open Food Facts product, payload schema version 1. Unknown nutrients are absent keys, never zero (PRD_FOOD 13.1).

FoodSource.description: Where a synchronised food came from. The embedded Ciqual catalogue is deliberately not a member: PRD_FOOD 21.1 marks it as reference data rather than personal data.

FoodUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of a custom food or a copied product, payload schema version 1.

HealthProfilePayloadV1.description: Health profile (PRD section 13.4), payload schema version 1. One aggregate per account, identified by the constant `me`. `heightCm` and `birthDate` are nullable and always present: null is a stated empty value, never an omission. `sex` is an optional addition of PRD_SCALE 22 and is absent when unstated, so a payload written before the field existed is still complete.

HealthProfileUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of the single health profile, payload schema version 1. The aggregate identifier is the constant `me`.

Instant.description: ISO-8601 instant in UTC, always suffixed with Z.

LocalDate.description: ISO-8601 calendar date, no time and no zone.

LocalTime.description: ISO-8601 local time, hours and minutes only, no zone.

MealPlanAggregateId.description: The business key of a proposal, `<date>:<slot>`. The separator is a colon: `aggregateIdSchema`'s alphabet has no `/`.

MealPlanEntryPayloadV1.description: One meal proposal, payload schema version 1. At most one per date and moment; the identifier is `<plannedOn>:<slot>` (PRD_FOOD 21.3).

MealPlanEntryUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of one meal proposal, payload schema version 1.

MealSlot.description: The moment of the day a line or a proposal belongs to (PRD_FOOD 8.4).

MeasurementPayloadV1.description: Weight measurement, payload schema version 1. `sourceType`, `impedanceOhm` and `bodyComposition` are optional additions of PRD_SCALE 22: a payload carrying none of them is complete and valid. Two rules the JSON Schema cannot express are enforced on parse: `bodyComposition.inputWeightCg` must equal `weightCg` (BR-SCALE-015), and `bodyComposition.fatFreeMassCg` must not exceed it (PRD_SCALE 13.2). A complete payload with no `bodyComposition` removes the one already stored for that date (BR-SCALE-007).

MeasurementSourceType.description: Business provenance of a weight (PRD_SCALE 21.1). The scale's local identifier, address and name are never carried (PRD_SCALE 16.2, 22).

MeasurementUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of a weight measurement, payload schema version 1.

MueErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable code. Known values: auth.forbidden, auth.unauthenticated, http.not_found, server.internal, server.unavailable, sync.aggregate_deleted, sync.invalid_cursor, sync.invalid_payload, sync.missing_required_field, sync.revision_conflict, sync.unknown_aggregate_type, sync.upgrade_required. Treat an unknown code as a non-retryable failure.

MutationEnvelope.description: One mutation (PRD section 12.2). Replaying it never repeats its effect.

MutationId.description: UUIDv7 identifying one mutation, globally unique and creation-ordered.

MutationOp.description: An upsert carries the full aggregate; a delete carries no payload.

Origin.description: The identity that authored a mutation, kept for audit (PRD section 14.7).

PayloadSchemaVersion.description: Version of the payload schema for one aggregate type.

PullRequest.description: Reads the journal after `cursor`. `supportedSchemaVersions` is required: it is what turns PRD section 12.4 into a server-enforced invariant.

PushRequest.description: A batch of local mutations. Order within the batch is the outbox order.

PushResponse.description: Exactly one result per submitted mutation, in submission order.

QuantityUnit.description: The unit `quantityThousandths` is stated in. `serving` selects the serving scale; a weight or a volume selects the ingredient scale.

RecipeIngredient.description: One ingredient, with a snapshot of its food's name so the recipe renders before the food arrives.

RecipePayloadV1.description: A recipe with its ingredients, payload schema version 1. The list is never empty: PRD_FOOD 21.2 forbids a recipe appearing without it.

RecipeType.description: Which meal a recipe belongs to (PRD_FOOD 8.3).

RecipeUpsertMutation.description: Upsert of a recipe with its ingredients, payload schema version 1.

ReferenceUnit.description: The unit the per-100 values are stated in (PRD_FOOD 8.6).

Revision.description: Per-aggregate revision. Compared for optimistic concurrency; never used as a cursor.

Sequence.description: Global per-user journal position. Strictly increasing. Ordering only; never compared to a revision.

ServingsThousandths.description: A serving count in thousandths, 0.25 to 10 in steps of 0.25 (PRD_FOOD 15). The step is part of the type: a value inside the range but off the quarter is refused.

SessionEquipment.description: A piece of gear attached to a session. `customName` is required for `other` and absent for every known type (PRD_ACTIVITIES 8.2 and 8.4).

Sex.description: Sex as the body-composition equations take it (PRD_SCALE FR-PROFILE-007, 13.2). Used for nothing else: BMI is unaffected and its adult categories are identical for everyone.

StrengthExercise.description: One exercise of a session, with its definition snapshot and its sets.

StrengthSet.description: One set. Every optional number is null when unrecorded and never zero (PRD_ACTIVITIES 9.4).

SupportedSchemaVersions.description: Aggregate type to the payload schema versions the client can apply.

SyncChange.description: One accepted change from the server journal (PRD section 12.3).

UpsertMutation.description: An upsert, carrying the complete aggregate for its type (PRD section 12.2).

UsualPortionsThousandths.description: A count of a food's usual servings, in thousandths: 0.5 to 20 in steps of 0.5 (PRD_FOOD 15).

androidBearer.description: Better Auth bearer token, one session per device so revocation is per-device (PRD section 15.3).

webSession.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session cookie, checked server-side.
webSession.name: better-auth.session_token

info.description: The `/api/v1` contract the Mue Android client is written against, plus the operational health checks. TanStack Start server functions and MCP tools are deliberately outside it (PRD section 20.4).
info.title: Mue Platform API

post.description: Returns a page of changes, or `upgrade_required` with no cursor at all when the server holds a payload version the caller did not declare (PRD sections 12.4 and 18).

200.description: A page of changes, or an upgrade demand.

post.summary: Read the change journal after a cursor.

post.description: Applies each mutation independently. A rejected mutation never blocks the rest (FR-SYNC-007), and replaying an already-applied `mutationId` returns the stored result (FR-SYNC-006).

503.description: At least one dependency did not.
